public_rationale: The September outputs did not establish a reliable solution: Alexander later reported that evaluators accepted only one of the five prompts. Google's broader benchmark showed progress, but relative preference is not proof of general compositional reliability. Marcus's central evidentiary point holds. His description understates the technical evaluation Google actually published.
limitations: Support applies to the claim that the cited evidence did not establish a general solution.
The independent scoring is reported retrospectively by Alexander.
The field-wide conclusion is an inference, not an exhaustive census of systems.
Later success on the bet would not reverse this September 2022 assessment.
